mentions.name: Eudaimonia
mentions.description: An alternative ad network tied to an ad blocker that selects and delivers ads based on how useful they are to users rather than how immediately profitable they are.
mentions.problem: Existing ad networks optimize for the most immediately profitable ads instead of the most useful ones.
